why: Weekly theme 'B2B Founder-led Growth' — Pillar: CASE_STUDY
draft:
We analyzed 40 B2B founders who crossed $1M ARR via LinkedIn.

Every single one followed these 3 non-negotiables:

• Documented client objections verbatim in a 'Story Bank'
• Published 3 teardowns a week with specific numerical metrics
• Commented thoughtfully on 10 prospective buyer posts daily before pitching

No hacks. Just consistent execution of high-signal craft.

Which of these 3 habits is hardest for your team to maintain?
source_context: Content Pillar: CASE_STUDY | Topic: Teardown: Scaling organic inbound without paid ads
